item.title: Palo Alto CEO Says AI Is Unearthing 50 Years of Coding Flaws
item.description:
Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora says Anthropic's Mythos is surfacing decades of human coding vulnerabilities in a very short span, and attackers are the ones profiting. He cited a dark-web case where a single attacker used an AI agent to breach 19 companies at once, arguing AI-driven attack scaling is only beginning.

原文标题：Palo Alto CEO 称 AI 正快速挖出 50 年代码漏洞

Why it matters：头部安全厂商 CEO 对 AI 漏洞挖掘与攻击规模化的公开判断，具备行业风向标价值。

item.title: Anthropic Reworks Engineer Promotions as AI Reshapes Software Work
item.description:
Anthropic platform engineering lead Caitlin Less says AI has compressed implementation work so much that project duration is no longer a useful promotion signal, with her team shifting to concrete impact such as latency reduction and incident avoidance. Hiring is also changing, adding agent-assisted coding tests to judge whether candidates can collaborate with coding agents on real work.

原文标题：Anthropic 调整工程师晋升标准 不再以项目耗时为核心

Why it matters：头部 AI 公司首次公开披露 AI 对工程师晋升与招聘评估体系的具体重构，对技术管理者与开发者职业规划有直接参考价值。

item.title: How Clay Builds Go-To-Market Agents for Any Harness
item.description:
Clay Head of AI Jeff Barg details how the company builds go-to-market infrastructure that any agent can use, noting usage is split roughly 50/50 between Clay's own agent and external harnesses like Claude Code. Clay has grown from about 50 to roughly 600 people with business up around 10x, and raised a new round in September, aiming for equivalent results regardless of which agent front-end customers choose.

原文标题：Clay 如何构建 GTM 智能体

Why it matters：首次系统披露 GTM 智能体架构与自研/外部 harness 双轨策略，对做垂直智能体与工具底座的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Finds 14 of 23 Unlearned Models Still Recall Cyberattack Facts
item.description:
Anthropic researchers found that 14 of 23 models trained to unlearn cyberattack knowledge still ranked the correct answers first, indicating post-hoc unlearning fails to reliably remove hazardous facts. The authors argue that because facts are recalled through neurons shared across many topics, post-training unlearning may never generalize, and dangerous knowledge may need to be isolated during training instead.

原文标题：Anthropic 发现 23 个遗忘模型有 14 个仍记得攻击知识

Why it matters：该研究直接质疑当前主流机器遗忘范式的有效性，对 AI 安全与模型对齐路线具有实质影响。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 74/100

item.title: OpenAI Fixes GPT-6.2 Billing Bug, Quota Burn Rate Rises 40%
item.description:
OpenAI confirmed a billing error during GPT-6.2's initial rollout that charged discounted quota rates for the Astra and Sol models. After the fix, Astra users hit usage limits 40% faster and Sol users 25% faster for the same workload, but OpenAI will not retroactively bill the shortfall and is granting Go, Plus, Pro and Business users one bankable quota reset as compensation.

原文标题：OpenAI 修复 GPT-6.2 计费错误 额度消耗加快 40%

Why it matters：涉及头部厂商计费机制与用户成本的实际变化，对重度订阅用户有直接决策价值。

item.title: SAP Weighs Cutting Over 10,000 Jobs in AI-First Restructuring
item.description:
Bloomberg reports SAP is considering cutting at least 10,000 jobs, roughly 9% of its global workforce, in an AI-centric restructuring focused on product engineering and sales. The move comes despite 13% year-over-year Q3 revenue growth and is seen as CEO Christian Klein reallocating resources behind an AI-first strategy that embeds generative AI and agents into enterprise software.

原文标题：SAP 拟裁员超 1 万人推进 AI 优先转型

Why it matters：欧洲最大软件公司以 AI 转型为名启动万人级重组，是企业软件与就业结构变迁的重要信号。

item.title: Novita and StreamLake Traced to ByteDance Ark Wrappers
item.description:
A routing-data investigation covering Nov 1-24 traces DeepSeek model traffic from Novita, StreamLake and Ant Digital back to ByteDance Ark, with Novita peaking at 1.1 trillion tokens in a single week. The post also maps Novita's layered offshore VIE ownership chain and notes that OpenRouter revoked its Zero Data Retention status.

原文标题：Novita 等三家推理服务商被指实为字节跳动 Ark 套壳

Why it matters：揭示第三方推理 API 的供应链套壳与数据合规风险，对选择模型服务商的团队有直接决策价值。

item.title: shadcn Unveils UI SDK Turning Components into Agent Primitives
item.description:
shadcn has released UI SDK, which decomposes UI components into behavior primitives that agents can invoke directly, such as opening popovers or moving focus with arrow keys, making the layer framework-agnostic. This lets agents compose and reuse the same interaction capabilities across React, Vue, Svelte and Solid.

原文标题：shadcn 推出 UI SDK 将组件拆解为 Agent 行为原语

Why it matters：为 Agent 与前端组件交互提供框架无关的标准化抽象，是 AI 辅助开发工具链的重要方向。

item.title: AI Coding Agents Revive Enthusiasm for Self-Hosting Infrastructure
item.description:
A long-time self-hoster reports that keeping infrastructure configs such as Docker Compose files and scripts in Git lets AI coding agents handle operational changes, sharply cutting the friction of trying new services and troubleshooting. The author argues AI does not change the core value of self-hosting but lowers the barrier enough to make it fun again.

原文标题：AI 编码智能体让自托管重新变得有趣

Why it matters：以真实运维实践说明 AI 编码智能体在自托管场景的降摩擦价值，对开发者有参考意义。

item.title: OpenRouter Data Shows Weakening Jevons Paradox for AI Tokens
item.description:
OpenRouter's 2026 data shows paid token volume grew 44x while spend rose only 7.6x, with average price per token down 83%. In the latest four weeks, tokens grew 39% while spend stayed flat, suggesting enterprises are banking price cuts as savings rather than expanding consumption, weakening the Jevons paradox effect.

原文标题：OpenRouter 数据揭示 AI 推理需求价格弹性减弱

Why it matters：以真实计费数据量化 AI 推理需求的价格弹性变化，对判断模型定价与商业化节奏有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 Tops Voice Arena Jarvis Bench at 999 Elo
item.description:
OpenAI's GPT-Live-1.1 debuted atop Voice Arena's Jarvis Bench overall leaderboard with 999 naturalness Elo and 1025 perceived task effectiveness, and hit 100% task success on live airline bookings using GPT 6.2 Sol Medium as its delegated backend. Yet human raters still preferred a human agent at 1288, and Gemini 3.8 Live scored higher on perceived call handling, showing naturalness, conversational quality and backend task completion diverge.

原文标题：OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 登顶语音基准 自然度 999 Elo

Why it matters：首个将语音自然度、通话观感与后端任务成功率分离评测的榜单结果，揭示了前沿语音模型各自的真实短板。

item.title: UW and Microsoft Unveil DualPM Dual-Track Agent Learning Method
item.description:
A joint University of Washington and Microsoft paper introduces DualPM, which reflects on every agent run, writes separate success and failure lessons, and merges them into two capped lists every 20 tasks. Tested with GPT-5.5 on 720 multi-domain tool-use tasks, failure lessons raised needed-tool discovery from 75.2% to 81.0%, success lessons cut turns from 6.1 to 5.4, and combining both lifted answer accuracy from 68.1% to 73.2%. The finding: failure lessons widen tool search while success lessons speed execution, so cost-sensitive deployments can rely on success lessons alone.

原文标题：华盛顿大学与微软提出 DualPM 双轨经验学习法

Why it matters：首次系统区分失败与成功经验在智能体自我改进中的不同作用，并给出可复现的量化收益。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · agent · signal 72/100

item.title: Ant Group's Robbyant Open-Sources LingBot-Navi Navigation Model with Spatial Memory
item.description:
Robbyant, Ant Group's embodied AI unit, has open-sourced LingBot-Navi, a navigation model that gives robots persistent spatial memory across tasks, so performance improves the longer a robot works in one place. It requires no pre-built map, constructing a 3D memory of layout, object positions and traversable paths during exploration, and pairs 3D surface locations with vision-language features to locate out-of-view targets. A scene-level planner predicts routes on the remembered layout while a local planner handles motion, obstacle avoidance and arrival detection.

原文标题：蚂蚁集团开源 LingBot-Navi 导航模型 让机器人拥有空间记忆

Why it matters：开源视觉语言导航模型引入跨任务空间记忆，直击具身智能中重复探索的痛点，具备明确的工程复用价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · opensource · signal 74/100

item.description:
Former OpenAI researcher Scott Aaronson sparked a viral X thread suggesting OpenAI or Anthropic may hold a fast method for factoring large integers, which would undermine RSA encryption. He later struck out the blog comment that started it, saying \\

item.title: Nvidia Pauses Chip Shipments to Southeast Asia Over Export Compliance
item.description:
Nvidia has told manufacturing partners including Dell and Super Micro to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia while it assesses whether regional partners comply with U.S. export requirements. The move targets a loophole that let Chinese firms remotely tap Nvidia chips in Southeast Asian data centers, which the U.S. Commerce Department moved to close this month; one think tank estimates such remote capacity supplies about 24% of China's AI compute.

原文标题：英伟达暂停向东南亚四国发货以核查出口合规

Why it matters：出口管制收紧直接冲击区域算力供应链，是理解中美 AI 算力格局变化的关键节点。

item.title: SAP Weighs Over 10,000 Job Cuts in AI-Driven Restructuring
item.description:
SAP is weighing at least 10,000 job cuts, roughly one in ten roles, as part of an AI-driven restructuring. The move comes despite record results: Q3 total revenue rose 13% to about $11.3B and cloud sales climbed 26% to about $7.3B.

原文标题：SAP 拟裁员逾 1 万人推进 AI 重组

Why it matters：企业软件巨头在业绩高增长期启动万人级 AI 重组，是观察 AI 对大型组织人力结构冲击的标志性事件。

item.title: Anthropic's Top-Cited AI Scientists Lead US Peers in 2025 Citations
item.description:
Drawing on the Stanford–Elsevier top 2% scientists list, this analysis compares 2025 citation counts for top-cited AI scientists at Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta. The typical top-cited AI scientist at Anthropic received 4,830 citations, well above OpenAI's 2,150, Google's 1,481 and Meta's 1,295. The gap likely reflects differing research cultures and publication strategies rather than a simple ranking of research strength.

原文标题：Anthropic 顶尖 AI 科学家引用量中位数达 4830

Why it matters：以统一榜单口径量化对比四家美国头部 AI 公司科学家的引用影响力，为观察人才与研究文化差异提供少见的数据视角。

item.title: Ex-OpenAI Researcher Says AI Producing Riemann Proof Matters More Than Proof Itself
item.description:
Complexity theorist and former OpenAI researcher Scott Aaronson argues in a blog post that proving the Riemann hypothesis would barely change daily life; the real milestone is that an AI system can produce such work at all. He says that capability could reshape the global economy or even threaten life on Earth, and dismisses the narrow view that only practical payoff matters.

原文标题：前 OpenAI 研究员称 AI 能产出黎曼证明本身更具冲击力

Why it matters：来自复杂度理论权威对 AI 数学能力意义的定性判断，为理解 AI 科研能力跃迁提供了有价值的视角。

item.title: Rvoip 0.5 Ships a Complete VoIP Stack Written in Rust
item.description:
Rvoip 0.5 unifies SIP, RTP, WebRTC, QUIC/WebTransport and voice-AI agents under a single call model, shipping everything as in-workspace Rust crates with no external SIP proxy, media server or RTP engine required. It carries release-gated interoperability evidence against Asterisk, FreeSWITCH and Jambonz, making it practical to build communications and voice-AI applications in pure Rust.

原文标题：Rvoip 0.5 发布 用 Rust 实现全栈 VoIP 通信

Why it matters：把完整 VoIP 与实时媒体栈收敛为纯 Rust 库并覆盖语音 AI 场景，对通信与 Agent 开发者有明确工程价值。

item.title: Scale AI and CMU Run 1,200 Experiments Comparing PPO and GRPO
item.description:
Researchers from Scale AI and Carnegie Mellon University ran more than 1,200 training experiments, including 96 with LLMs, to systematically compare PPO and GRPO. They found that PPO with a critic clearly wins at small RL batch sizes, while GRPO closes the gap as batches grow. On terminal-agent tasks PPO led by up to 5.9 points at batch sizes 128 and 512, with all methods within 0.6 points at 2,048; PPO at batch 128 matched GRPO at 512 using 91 versus 342 GPU-hours.

原文标题：Scale AI 与 CMU 实测 1200 次训练揭示 PPO 小批量优势

Why it matters：大规模受控实验直接挑战 DeepSeek-R1 后开源社区默认弃用 critic 的主流做法，对 RL 训练选型有明确指导价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: BUI Charts Debuts as Self-Proclaimed Largest 2D Chart Library
item.description:
The BUI ecosystem has released bui-charts, a component library built on the Rust-based BlenderUI framework that lets developers declare 2D charts such as XYChart, BarGauge, candlestick, flame graph and ternary plots via the rsx! macro, with signal-driven automatic redraws. It markets itself as the world's largest 2D chart library, but the available material focuses on installation and a starter example without chart counts, benchmarks or comparisons against mainstream libraries.

原文标题：BUI Charts 发布 号称全球最大 2D 图表库

Why it matters：Rust 声明式 UI 生态新增图表组件库，对关注 Rust 前端与可视化工具链的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: Ant Group's Robbyant Releases LingBot-Map 2.0 with In-Inference Map Refinement
item.description:
Robbyant, Ant Group's embodied AI unit, released LingBot-Map 2.0, which builds 3D maps from ordinary video while the camera moves and adds a Refine step that revises the model's existing spatial memory mid-run to curb accumulated drift. On the multi-kilometer VBR benchmark around Rome (up to 5.2 km, ~18,800 frames), average trajectory error drops from 31.12 m in v1.0 to 4.72 m in 2.0 with Refine, all inside normal inference with no external optimization backend. Code and weights are available for the Streaming version.

原文标题：蚂蚁集团 Robbyant 发布 LingBot-Map 2.0 轨迹误差降至 4.72 米

Why it matters：把闭环地图修正内化进模型推理并开源权重，是具身智能空间感知路线的实质性进展。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 74/100

item.title: OpenAI Fixes Billing Bug, Users Hit GPT-6.2 Astra Limits 40% Faster
item.description:
A billing bug during the GPT-6.2 rollout gave most users incorrect discounts on GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol. After the fix, quotas now deplete 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol, though OpenAI will not retroactively charge users and is granting all paid tiers an extra saved reset plus free Fast Mode for Business accounts through year-end. OpenAI is also testing a merge of Chat and Work modes with select Pro users.

Why it matters：涉及头部厂商计费错误与额度政策调整，直接影响订阅用户的成本与使用预期。

item.description:

item.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources 7B Math Model Scoring 51.7% on MATH
item.description:
DeepSeek released DeepSeekMath 7B, initialized from DeepSeek-Coder-v1.5 7B and continually pre-trained on 500B math-related tokens. It scores 51.7% on the competition-level MATH benchmark without external tools or voting, approaching Gemini-Ultra and GPT-4. Base, instruct, and RL checkpoints are open-sourced for research.

原文标题：DeepSeek 开源 7B 数学模型 竞赛级 MATH 得分 51.7%

Why it matters：7B 小模型在竞赛级数学基准上逼近顶级闭源模型，且三档权重全部开源，对数学推理与开源生态均有实质价值。

item.title: AI 发现药物至今零获批 1452 天等待仍未破局
item.description:
一个追踪网站以 FDA/EMA 审批为唯一口径统计，截至 2026 年 11 月，由 AI 发现或设计的药物获批数量仍为零，尚无任何疾病被 AI 发现的疗法治愈。目前有 117 个 AI 相关候选药物进入人体试验、来自 63 家公司，其中仅 Rentosertib 一个进入 III 期且仍属在研。该页面用硬性审批数据对冲行业高调预期，为评估 AI for Science 落地进度提供了可核验的参照。

Why it matters：以审批硬指标量化 AI 制药真实进度，是校准行业预期的关键事实参照。

item.description:

item.title: SimDrop 将 iOS 模拟器接入 Finder 侧边栏
item.description:
SimDrop 是一款开源 macOS 工具，把已启动的 iOS 模拟器以文件夹形式挂载到 Finder 侧边栏，用户可直接拖拽文件进出模拟器的照片库与下载目录，也可通过终端路径访问。该工具需 macOS 15 及以上，采用 GPL-3.0 协议开源，已签名公证并支持 Homebrew 安装。

Why it matters：面向 iOS 开发者的实用小工具，解决模拟器文件互传的具体摩擦，但影响面限于本地开发场景。

item.title: 美国数据封锁致中国大模型延期至 2027 年
item.description:
受美国芯片出口管制、云算力漏洞封堵与反蒸馏执法叠加影响，智谱与月之暗面的下一代旗舰模型被迫延期，智谱约 3 万亿参数的 GLM-5.5 从 2026 年 11 月推迟至 2027 年一季度。两家公司正转向 Google 与 Meta 的公开数据源以填补训练数据缺口，标志着中美 AI 竞争从算力层延伸至数据供给层。
